decisions.reason: Accepting HubSpot default reports as a temporary reporting fallback does not change the deferred and unresolved direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization requirement.
The reporting-format decision does not alter how leads are transferred from HubSpot to MeetAlfred.
Using HubSpot default reports does not change the MeetAlfred campaign-creation or Zap setup workflow.
The HubSpot reporting fallback is unrelated to the provisioned campaign domain and registrar.
